stem.text: The forward reaction of a reversible reaction is exothermic and has an activation energy of $+30\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
The reverse reaction proceeds by a mechanism that is the exact reverse of the mechanism of the forward reaction.
Which statement about the activation energy of the reverse reaction is correct?

A.text: The activation energy for the reverse reaction is equal to $-30\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.

B.text: The activation energy for the reverse reaction is greater than $0\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ but less than $+30\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.

C.text: The activation energy for the reverse reaction is equal to $+30\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.

D.text: The activation energy for the reverse reaction is greater than $+30\,\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$.
